entities.name: Gherridarigaaz
entities.description: Powerful Shivan dragon who allied with Urza and died protecting him in Serra's Realm.

entities.name: Rhammidarigaaz
entities.description: Her son, viashino champion who later leads the Dragon Nations and is a reincarnated Primeval.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Forced Gherridarigaaz to leave the viashino alone and recruited her.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: Site of the battle where she died.

entities.name: Radiant
entities.description: Caster of the spell that Gherridarigaaz blocked.

entities.name: Primevals
entities.description: Godlike beings, one of which Rhammidarigaaz reincarnated.

events.summary: Angered that her son chose to be the viashino's champion, Gherridarigaaz is threatened by Urza into leaving the viashino alone.
events.quote: Urza threatened Gherridarigaaz into leaving the viashino alone

events.summary: Urza recruits her against the Invasion of Tolaria and then for the battle in Serra's Realm by returning her son.
events.quote: delivering her son back to her

events.summary: Gherridarigaaz dies sacrificing herself to protect Urza from Radiant's spell.
events.quote: Gherridarigaaz died sacrificing herself to protect Urza

relations.quote: who allied herself with Urza on Dominaria
